title: Record Scratch
blurb: The record scratch — the sound that stops time. Paired forever with a freeze-frame and 'yep, that's me — you're probably wondering how I got here,' it's the universal signal that something has gone off script. Use it to interrupt, to rewind, or to open any story that starts at the worst possible moment. A cornerstone of comedic editing grammar.
origin: The vinyl-scratch interrupt, canonized by the freeze-frame narration trope.
